name: Iwami (Tottori, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iwami town emblem in red: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Iwami, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 December 1957.

features.role: Iwami town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
